Your creation process, simplified

From an idea to a worksheet — in four clear steps.

  1. Step 1

    Choose Your Idea

    Browse the prompt collection and pick the activity page you want to create.

  2. Step 2

    Generate Your Illustration

    Use the prompt with your preferred AI image-generation tool.

  3. Step 3

    Convert Into Tracing

    TraceCraft transforms your illustration into a tracing-style page.

  4. Step 4

    Assemble Your Product

    Arrange pages in Canva or any design tool into worksheets, bundles or books.

It's really this simple: create the image → add it to TraceCraft → your product is ready.

No design skills. No hours of editing. Just generate the image from the prompt, drop it into the tracing software, and your page is done.
